tldr: Lilith in Pisces: the wound felt without skin; escape as the answer to pain.
body: With Lilith in Pisces, every rejection cuts deep and the exit is inward: fantasy, isolation, numbing habits, or the victim role that wins comfort while dodging responsibility. The real world feels too sharp, so the shadow builds a softer one to hide in.
gift: Imagination, compassion, and spiritual depth once feeling deeply stops requiring escape.
challenge: Escapism and numbing habits that quietly take over, playing the victim to avoid choices, drifting without direction.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
